validation.nameRequired: Enter a name — your teammates will see it.
validation.passwordShort: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
validation.passwordLong: Password is too long (128 characters max).

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again in a moment.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and retry.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.social: Sign-in with that provider didn't complete. Try again or use your email.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: This email hasn't been verified yet.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already registered — just sign in.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: This email is already registered — just sign in.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: Password is too long (128 characters max).
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.INVALID_USER: The signed-in account doesn't match this link. Sign out first, then open it again.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS_REQUEST_NEW_CODE: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
errors.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Your account is temporarily locked — try again later.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email than the account you're signed in with.
errors.email_not_verified: Verify your email before accepting the invitation.
errors.already_member: You're already a member of this organization.
errors.seat_limit: This organization has no seats left. Ask the person who invited you.
errors.not_found: The invitation doesn't exist or is no longer valid.
errors.invalid_signature: This link is no longer valid. Go back to the desktop app and sign in again.
errors.DEVICE_CODE_ALREADY_PROCESSED: This code has already been handled.
errors.DEVICE_CODE_NOT_CLAIMED: Enter the code first, then confirm.

login.title: Sign in to bianfa
login.desc: Sign in with your email and password.
login.desktopDesc: After signing in you'll be sent straight back to the desktop app.
login.unverified: This email isn't verified yet — open the verification link we sent you.
login.resent: Verification email sent again. Check your inbox.
login.totpDesc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signup.title: Create your bianfa account
signup.desc: Free account — your notes sync across devices.
signup.checkMail: We sent a verification email to {{email}}.
signup.checkMailDetail: The link is valid for 15 minutes. Check your spam folder, or resend it.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.desc: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If that email is registered, a password reset email is on its way.
forgot.sentDetail: The link is valid for 30 minutes. Check your spam folder if it doesn't show up.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.desc: Choose a new password. Other devices will be signed out.
reset.doneDetail: Sign in with the new password — the desktop app will need to sign in again too.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.invalidDetail: Reset links last 30 minutes and can only be used once.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.doneDetail: You can go back to the desktop app and continue signing in, or manage your account here.
verify.expiredDetail: Links last 15 minutes. You can request a new one when signing in.
verify.invalidDetail: It may have been used already, or it's incomplete.

consent.title: Authorize access
consent.scopeOffline: Stay signed in while you're away (to sync notes)
consent.returningDetail: If the browser doesn't redirect, switch back to the desktop app.
consent.missing: This page has to be opened from the desktop sign-in flow.
consent.missingDetail: Go back to the desktop app and click Sign in once more.

device.title: Connect the desktop app
device.desc: Enter the 8-character code shown in the desktop app.
device.codeInvalid: The code is {{n}} letters or digits.
device.codeUnknown: We don't know that code — check it for typos.
device.reviewTitle: Allow this device to sign in?
device.reviewDesc: {{client}} is asking to sign in with your account.
device.reviewHint: Make sure the code in the desktop app matches this one before allowing.
device.approved: You can go back to the desktop app
device.approvedDetail: It will finish signing in within a few seconds. You can close this page.
device.deniedDetail: The desktop app will not sign in. If this wasn't you, consider changing your password.
device.expiredDetail: Go back to the desktop app and click Sign in again to get a new code.
device.taken: This code is already in use by another account
device.takenDetail: Go back to the desktop app and click Sign in again for a new code.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.loginHint: Sign in or sign up with the invited email to accept.
invite.acceptedDetail: Team notes will show up in the desktop app.
invite.rejectedDetail: The person who invited you will see that you didn't join.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired
invite.invalidDetail: Invitations last 48 hours. Ask the sender to invite you again.

account.title: Account
account.desc: Sync, teams and devices are managed in the desktop app.
account.unverified: Your email isn't verified yet — open the verification link we sent you.
account.desktopHint: Manage devices and teams from Settings in the desktop app.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be incomplete, or the page has moved.
